title: AntiItemExplode
description: Prevents dropped items from being destroyed by End Crystals, TNT, Respawn Anchors etc!
body:
Ever lost your gear to an explosion in PvP? This plugin fixes that.

When items are dropped on the ground, they are fully protected from any explosion damage. End Crystals, TNT, Respawn Anchors, none of them will destroy your loot.

Explosions still work normally. Players still take damage, blocks still break. The only difference is that dropped items survive.

No commands. No permissions. No configuration needed to get started. Just drop it in your plugins folder and it works.

**Compatible with Paper/Spigot**

**If Any Bugs Found, Contact @corex0056 on discord**
